title: Theo and the Postcards
author: Petra Thackeray
blurb: Elodie Sterling, a translator losing a childhood language one borrowed word at a time, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. Then a childhood home goes up for auction — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must forgive the stranger in the old photographs, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
